spec.name: Gearbox output bracket
spec.description: End-mounted steel bracket carrying a 40 N*m torque about x through two drive lugs; y is height and z is depth.

meta.lug_placement: Patches lie flush with the top and bottom edges and are centered in depth.
meta.torque_calculation: 625 N times 64 mm between lug centers equals 40000 N*mm, or 40 N*m.
